text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Even after coming this far, Gran-chan's 
legs haven't slowed down one bit...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Still, in a 2000m race, this is where it 
really starts getting tough...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (When it comes to tenacity—I won't lose!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Here I come, Mileeeer!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Wh-what... So fast!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: This is the speed of Gran Alegria!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Strong, so strong! 1st place goes to Gran 
Alegria! A historic victory is made here 
today!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I did…… ittttttaaaaarrrrghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I won, I won! Champion across three 
divisions!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. A total defeat for me. 
Not much I could do against speed like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
My speed won't cut it. I'll have to come 
up with another countermeasure!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Conquering three divisions through sheer 
speed... proof of the absolute strongest. 
It was a run truly worthy of a historic 
milestone..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To serve as that final wall standing in 
your way... It is truly an honor...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because Chrono-chan and the others 
were my opponents, conquering the medium 
distances truly meant something.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"You can't call it a three-division sweep 
unless you beat the toughest opponents, 
after all!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Congratulations. And here I was confident 
in my tenacity.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To build up this much stamina... That was 
truly a magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I always knew how tenacious you are, 
Bouquet-san! Thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(A roar of cheers so loud it shook the 
grandstands)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (I can't hear anyone else's voices. But—)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (I can spot you right away!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I won!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Three distance categories conquered!!
choice_data_list: Yeah! We made it here together!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes, together! Fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-san. Is this view just as you 
imagined it back then?
That day, when I dreamed of her potential.

Imagining conquering three categories and 
receiving the roaring applause praising 
the true Queen of the Mile made my heart 
race.
However—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on conquering three 
categories, Gran! You are the true Queen 
of the Mile!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I knew you could do it, Gran-chan! Thank 
you soooo much for showing us the best 
moment ever!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
At last... your long-cherished dream has 
finally come true...! I'm so happy for 
you, brilliant job, Gran Alegria!
choice_data_list:
It's infinitely more wonderful than I 
imagined!

text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Everyone, I conquered all three divisions!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Gran, congratulations—!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks for the support! Infinite 
miles of gratitude♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
How was my run? Miles really are the 
strongest after all, right?☆

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The reason I was able to reach this level 
of running is because of Trainer and 
Master—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to the rivals I competed 
with and the seniors who trained alongside 
me!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Everything I've received—all of it 
together— is what makes Gran Alegria's 
running!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The reason I'm strong— is because I am 
Gran Alegria!!
(Gran! Gran! Gran!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You've joined the ranks of legends too, 
Gran-chan."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Still, there can only be one legend in 
any given era, right?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to challenge her. At the mile. 
This time, I will be the one who wins!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what incredible cheers! I can hear 
congratulations coming from everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So this is the view beyond conquering 
three divisions...! The sight I've longed 
to see...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Awesome! Thanks, Gran!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This scenery that you made a reality for 
me, I will never forget it!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: Haha... You really pulled it off, Gran.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Conquering three divisions with mile 
speed. I see, at last...!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Still, seeing this sight... hearing these 
cheers... makes me truly happy."

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is celebrating your achievements 
as if they were their own, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Until now, only a handful of people 
sympathized with their feelings.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: Yet right now, there are so many...!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
For an Umamusume, this has got to be the 
greatest happiness in the world!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It's a future I could never have reached 
on my own...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All right, just like this, we're gonna 
sweep the Spring-Autumn Mile races!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let's show them the run of a true 
Mile Queen at the Mile Championship!
